data.name: ChatGPT Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the OpenAI ChatGPT API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from platform.openai.com/api-keys; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to OpenAI.

data.name: Claude Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the Anthropic Claude API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from console.anthropic.com; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to Anthropic.

data.name: Color Coded Lyrics
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds multi-version K-Pop and Asian pop lyrics at Color Coded Lyrics (colorcodedlyrics.com) featuring Hangul/original text, Latin Romanization, and English translations with member line distribution.

data.name: DeepL Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the DeepL API. Needs your own API key (a Free key ends with :fx); the lines, and the title and artist when song context is on, are sent to DeepL.

data.name: DeepSeek Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the DeepSeek API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from platform.deepseek.com; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to DeepSeek.

data.name: Gemini Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the Google Gemini API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from aistudio.google.com/app/apikey; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to Google.

data.name: Grok Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the xAI Grok API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from console.x.ai; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to xAI.

data.name: J-Lyric
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds lyrics at J-Lyric.net (j-lyric.net) for Japanese songs (J-Pop, Anisong, Vocaloid, Enka). Licensed by JASRAC and NexTone.

data.name: Kugou Music
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at Kugou Music (酷狗音乐) through its official desktop lyric API. Not affiliated with Kugou or Tencent Music Entertainment.

data.name: Musixmatch
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at Musixmatch through its mobile API. Not affiliated with Musixmatch; it may stop working when the service changes.

data.name: NetEase Cloud Music
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at NetEase Cloud Music through its unofficial web API. Not affiliated with NetEase; it may stop working when the service changes. Translations are not used.

data.name: NhacCuaTui
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at NhacCuaTui through its unofficial web API. Not affiliated with NhacCuaTui; it may stop working when the service changes.

data.name: OpenAI-compatible Translate
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Translates lyrics line by line with any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, SiliconFlow, etc.), keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Configure your Base URL, API key and Model name in settings.

data.name: PetitLyrics
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at PetitLyrics (プチリリ) through its mobile API. Supports word-synced (WSY), line-synced (LSY), and plain text lyrics. Not affiliated with SyncPower Corporation.

data.name: QQ Music
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at QQ Music (QQ音乐) through its unofficial web API. Not affiliated with QQ Music or Tencent; it may stop working when the service changes.

data.name: Spotify
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at Spotify (open.spotify.com) through its web player API. Requires a valid sp_dc cookie configured in plugin settings.

data.name: ZingMP3
data.author: kanaru313
data.description: Finds synced (LRC) lyrics at ZingMP3 through its unofficial web API. Not affiliated with ZingMP3; it may stop working when the service changes.
